description: This file is an HTML document representing the frontend interface for a database visualizer application. It includes HTML markup, embedded CSS styles for layout and appearance, and JavaScript code responsible for fetching data from API endpoints, handling user interactions, and dynamically rendering database, table, and data views.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases from the server.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Dynamically constructs an HTML table to display data rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates a table cell content based on data type, handling large and object-like content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content for long text or objects.
